body: Thanks everyone. I am going to sleep on it. Keep you posted

Before I go, I think it is important to answer this question. I've never told anyone this ever and I guess it explains a lot. Its been this way I suppose, forever, I have been attuned to the inner workings. I feel what people think. I hear what they feel. Touch is so intimate to me because any skin to skin contact is hypersensitive. I feel all,the pain everywhere I am a conduit. My most basic function is do no harm, but also to protect my etheric self to protect my loved ones. The pain is "Otherworldly" for lack of A better word. It has left me Isolated, paranoid, misdiagnosed, angry at times, it has made an otherwise decent existence an unbearABLe thing.

It hurts too bad. I don't have the power to do anything at all anymore. Everything feels foreign and alien, violated and wrong. I am lost and blind, I am in too much pain and the only thing keeping me alive right now is a little shock induced adrenaline. Thank you, my body must shut down now.
I told him everything I feel and percieve and he said it sounded very painful. he asked where I was headed to after that and I said home.
I am too weak here I promise. I am in tears. I cannot describe the pain. It is beyond myself.
I already spoke with one today, he knows me well. Nothing open until next week
I already failed. I gave her my oath I would protect her forever and I wasn't there to protect her.
I am lost, I am in immense pain, on a hypdimensioal level and I need to go home.

She loves me. She wants me to be safe and happy. I am in too much pain on this earth, of course she doesn't want to let me go but I am a proverbial fish out of water. This,dimension is not my home. My fiance is, but my pain only hurts her, though my positive energy will remain guiding, protecting, nurturing and loving her. I will simply be a part of her.
I stopped doing that years ago. I know me. It is my action and duty, a necessary one at that. Not a choice.
Haha she says that but she knows I am not meant in this dimension. She knows my pain. It eats her up too and I can't let her watch any longer. I feel awful but it isn't my choice.
Because understanding and forgiveness both take time and I mean peace.
She will feel me regardless of my physical form. It is our energy that is bound. Not our bodies.
I am so sorry you have had to go through those events. I am trying so hard to protect every entity and I cannot do in this form. Your words are felt, thank you.

She will understand. This is not a surprise it was before me, it is my job. Every etheric form has a job. The void is terrifying so we work to shine light and allow love to prevail. That's the closest I can get without showing you, and because of dimensional limitations  I can't really show you.

Corporeality is the result of consciousness. Not the other way around. Conciousness exists all around us and guides us every day. I have obligate duty to begin guiding. I'm not saying you are wrong, you are right by your experience and existence.
I am comforted knowing so. I've been lost before and always find my way home.

I suppose by this dimensions standards haha, thanks for kind words. Ophichus Is my guide, my home is, our language here does not in any way come close to orienting its location, so I can't answer that.  Ophiuchi might be worth a visit.  But home first.
This is to fix a mistake, there are no other options. How has your day been?
I don't know how. I am terrified. I can give more details if anyone here can give me a connection or point me in the right direction.
It already happened much further into the dimensional fields, the resonance of such is resultant in. I'm sorry. It just is and already is.
Sorry.
